user.title: Add template climate
user.description: Create a climate entity driven by templates. Every field except the name is optional; attributes without a template run in optimistic (assumed state) mode.

data_description.availability: Template resolving to true/false to mark the entity (un)available.
data_description.current_temperature_template: Template returning the current temperature, e.g. {{ states('sensor.room_temp') }}.
data_description.hvac_mode_template: Template returning the current HVAC mode. Leave empty for optimistic mode.
data_description.hvac_action_template: Template returning the current HVAC action (heating, cooling, idle, ...).
data_description.set_hvac_mode: Actions run when the HVAC mode is changed. The chosen mode is available as {{ hvac_mode }}.
data_description.set_temperature: Actions run when the target temperature is changed. Available variables: {{ temperature }}, {{ target_temp_high }}, {{ target_temp_low }}, {{ hvac_mode }}.
data_description.set_humidity: Actions run when the target humidity is changed. Available as {{ humidity }}.
data_description.set_fan_mode: Actions run when the fan mode is changed. Available as {{ fan_mode }}.
data_description.set_preset_mode: Actions run when the preset mode is changed. Available as {{ preset_mode }}.
data_description.set_swing_mode: Actions run when the swing mode is changed. Available as {{ swing_mode }}.
data_description.precision: Precision the temperature is displayed with (0.1, 0.5 or 1.0).

error.invalid_template: One of the templates is invalid.
error.invalid_action: One of the actions is invalid.
